# bc7enc

`bc7enc.cpp`, `bc7enc.h`, and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from
[richgel999/bc7enc_rdo](https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc_rdo/tree/b9438627eef73a1157e84201b6fa6eb2ffd6d9f0),
commit `b9438627eef73a1157e84201b6fa6eb2ffd6d9f0`.

Media Server elects the MIT license (Alternative A in LICENSE). Only the BC7
block encoder is compiled; no RDO CLI, decoder, sample, or other codec is imported.
It runs during explicit model ingest on a worker, after role-specific mip filtering.
Updates must repeat the compressed texture GPU and determinism tests.
